descriptions.survival: Classic survival with land claims, a player economy and seasonal events. No pay-to-win: ranks are comfort and cosmetics.
descriptions.anarchy: No rules, no claims, no resets. Everything you build can be raided, and everything they build can be yours.
descriptions.minigames: Bed Wars, Sky Wars and parkour in one lobby. Short rounds, ranked seasons, new maps every month.

product.adultNote: Cases are for players 18+. You confirm your age before the first opening.
product.fairNote: Odds are published and every opening can be verified.

how.title: From the shop to your game in three steps
how.step1: Choose a server and add items. One cart can hold items for several servers.
how.step2: Enter your nickname and email, then pay by card, BLIK or Przelewy24.
how.step3: Items arrive in game within seconds. Track delivery on the order page.

fair.title: Case odds you can check yourself
fair.lead: Before you open a case we publish a hash of the server seed. You choose the client seed. The result is computed from both, so neither side can change it afterwards. Try it with the demo seeds below — your browser does the maths.
fair.demo: Demo seeds. Real openings use a fresh server seed per order.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: My item didn't arrive. What now?
faq.a1: Most items arrive within seconds. If the order page still says pending after 10 minutes, write to us with your order number — failed deliveries are retried automatically and refunded if they keep failing.
faq.a2: Items are delivered immediately, so refunds are only possible when delivery fails or after review by an admin. Orders with an opened case can't be refunded.
faq.q3: Do I need a premium Minecraft account?
faq.a3: No. Our servers accept offline accounts, so your nickname is your identity. Double-check it before paying.
faq.a4: This is a demo. Payments run in Stripe test mode and no real money is charged.
